<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Asset">
  <rdfs:comment>A physical or logical component of a water distribution infrastructure.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Asset</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 asks which assets compose the infrastructure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: Which assets compose a water distribution infrastructure?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterDistributionInfrastructure">
  <rdfs:comment>The system of pipes, pumps, and other components that distribute water.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water Distribution Infrastructure</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 asks about the infrastructure composed by assets</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: Which assets compose a water distribution infrastructure?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Sensor">
  <rdfs:comment>A device that detects or measures a physical property in water systems.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Sensor</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks which sensor types are used in water infrastructures</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterInfrastructure">
  <rdfs:comment>The physical facilities and systems used to manage water resources.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water Infrastructure</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04, CQ05, CQ06 refer to water infrastructures where sensors, actuators, and meters are used</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Actuator">
  <rdfs:comment>A component that controls or moves a mechanism in water systems.</rdfs:comment>

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterMeter">

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.
    (competency_question) CQ08: What is the fabrication number of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ09: What are the manufacturer and the model of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ10: What is the version of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ11: What is the hardware version number of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ12: What firmware version is the water meter using?
    (competency_question) CQ18: What is the power of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What is the radio frequency level of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ20: What is the geolocation of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ38: What is the start date and time of the tariff in use in the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ39: What is the duration of the current tariff of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ40: What is the tariff period of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ42: What is the billing date of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ43: What is the billing date period of the water meter?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Device"/>

</owl:Class>

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Function">

</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#TemporalSetting">

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ37: Which water indicators are defined for Burgos?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#City">

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#usedIn">
